storyline.real: Verstappen leads from pole at his home race. Mercedes splits its cars: Hamilton stops first at both rounds of stops, chasing the undercut, and Bottas runs long and leads for a while. Verstappen stops a lap after Hamilton each time, passes Bottas on lap 30 and wins by 20.9 s, after Hamilton's late stop for fastest lap.

eras.briefing: Zandvoort, 2021. Verstappen started from pole at home and leads Hamilton by three and a half seconds, seventeen laps in. You run him. Mercedes has two cars to play: Hamilton can try the undercut, and Bottas can stay out long. Cover them and win.
